baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive construction at خُلِقَ and the predicate هَلُوعًا attach the quality to the formed disposition of ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A socially present human being is formed with an inner pressure pattern of rapid alarm, low endurance, and grasping retention; the verse describes a constitutional response architecture rather than one anxious episode.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence identifies the subject as manifest social humanity and generalizes the pressure pattern beyond an isolated individual.
Inner disposition and character make the passive creation clause function as constitutional formation.
Anxious, grasping impatience supplies the low-endurance alarm and retention dynamics of the disposition.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely labels humans as anxious.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents a built-in human response architecture: alarm escalates quickly under pressure and need contracts into grasping retention.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus sequence joins perceptive humanity, passive proportioning, and a rare predicate whose inventory includes sharp rapid movement.
baseline_models.mechanism: Human perception is proportioned for fast detection and movement. On this reading, the problem named by هَلُوعًا is not responsiveness itself but responsiveness whose speed outruns endurance and regulation.

activation_trace.role: Perceiving by sight, sound, or felt awareness supplies a sensitive detection surface for the human subject.
Measuring and proportioning recast creation as calibrated design rather than an undifferentiated moral label.
Sharp rapid movement contributes the fast-output channel whose excess can become restless reactivity.

changed_reading.before: هَلُوعًا names only a static vice.
changed_reading.after: هَلُوعًا can name dysregulated speed in an otherwise useful perceptive system: detection becomes action before endurance can govern it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first calls for containment of panic and then contrasts two estimates of the same event: they see it distant, while it is seen as temporally near. Activated against perceptive humanity and impatient alarm, هَلُوعًا becomes reactivity distorted by a short horizon rather than fear alone.

activation_trace.role: Perceptive awareness supplies the focus-side faculty whose horizon can be miscalibrated.
Anxious impatience supplies the focus-side pressure that a remote estimate leaves ungoverned.
Holding the self back from panic supplies the regulatory operation opposed to impatient discharge.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the first perspective from which the event is estimated.
Distance from nearness gives that first perspective its long-horizon judgment.
The same seeing branch supplies the counter-perspective, making the contrast one of appraisal rather than different events.
Temporal approach and an ending drawing near compress the horizon that human appraisal had stretched.

structural_cues: 70:5-7 places self-restraint immediately before a parallel distant-versus-near sight contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint, two acts of seeing, and opposed horizons; I infer that horizon error feeds the focus trait. A live alternative is that the contrast corrects eschatological knowledge without explaining هَلُوعًا causally.

changed_reading.before: Human anxiety is a fixed intensity independent of appraisal.
changed_reading.after: Human anxiety is partly a horizon failure: what is treated as remote cannot regulate the immediate alarm system, so patient containment bridges the scales.

context_deltas.mechanism: Under terminal threat, the closest human bonds become proposed substitutes for the self, while property is gathered and put into a container. The activated mechanism is a single scarcity processor with opposite flows: export loss onto persons and prevent valued goods from flowing out.

activation_trace.role: Familiar comfort and companionship supply the social bonds whose normal sheltering function is reversed under threat.
Grasping impatience supplies the scarcity pressure that protects the self and retained goods at others' expense.
Making one thing a ransom for another supplies the substitution rule by which relationships become expendable.
Joining dispersed things into one collection supplies the inward acquisition phase of hoarding.
Putting a thing into a containing vessel supplies closure after acquisition and blocks recirculation.

structural_cues: 70:11-14 expands the proposed ransom from sons through intimate relations to everyone on earth, while 70:18 compresses the reverse material motion into gathering then containing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a widening ransom chain and a gather-container pair; I infer one threat economy linking social substitution to material retention. A live alternative is that the two sequences portray separate offender types rather than one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The grasping side of هَلُوعًا is merely private stinginess.
changed_reading.after: The grasping disposition can become an emergency allocation system that liquidates relationships as substitutes while sealing property against outflow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same touch construction feeds opposite valences into one system. Harm cuts through patience and produces panic; beneficial good reaches the system and produces a hand withheld from giving. هَلُوعًا therefore governs both loss sensitivity and gain retention as a bidirectional threshold failure.

activation_trace.role: Inner disposition makes the paired outputs expressions of one formed response system.
Alarm plus grasping supplies both poles that the following clauses separate experimentally.
An effect reaching and striking the person supplies the common input channel for the harmful trial.
Harm and badness assign negative valence to the first input without changing the touch mechanism.
The cutting off of patience supplies the panic output as a failure of endurance.
The repeated reaching effect holds the input channel constant for the beneficial trial.
Inclination toward useful good assigns positive valence to the second input.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies the gain-retention output that mirrors panic under loss.

structural_cues: 70:20-21 repeats the same conditional touch syntax and changes only input valence and output behavior.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a controlled syntactic pair and branch-distinct outputs; I infer a shared threshold system rather than two unrelated vices. The live alternative is a simple list of bad reactions with no internal systems claim.

changed_reading.after: هَلُوعًا is a two-sided regulation failure: adverse contact terminates endurance, while beneficial contact terminates circulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exception builds a counter-regulatory loop rather than merely denying the focus description. Recurrent worship stabilizes time; wealth is no longer an unbounded possession but bears a fixed due claimed by request and deprivation; guarding the practice closes the loop. The response architecture remains human but its outputs are trained and socially routed.

activation_trace.role: Inner disposition supplies the default architecture that the exception must regulate rather than erase.
Alarm and grasping define the outputs redirected by recurring practice and enforceable claims.
Prayer as binding worship supplies the repeated practice named by the exception.
Stillness and continuity turn episodic worship into a stable temporal regulator.
Acquired or abundant wealth supplies the stock that grasping would otherwise close around.
A binding due and fixed entitlement convert voluntary release into an obligation already belonging outside the holder.
Request and seeking provide an audible social claim on the fixed due.
Deprivation and loss of the desired good extend the claim to need that may remain unvoiced.
Adherence and sustained observance supply maintenance at the far bracket of the ethical sequence.

structural_cues: 70:22 marks an exception, and 70:23-34 brackets a repeated ethical profile with continual and guarded prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exception, persistent practice, wealth, a fixed due, and named claimants; I infer a regulatory loop that retrains intake and outflow. A live alternative is that the list identifies already different people rather than causing change in the same architecture.

changed_reading.before: Being created هَلُوعًا fixes conduct as an immutable defect.
changed_reading.after: Created reactivity is a default but governable architecture: durable practice steadies alarm, and fixed claims convert withholding into dependable circulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later crowds repeatedly acquire forward vector: they rush toward the addressee while coveting entry, then emerge at speed toward a conspicuous erected marker. Coupled with the focus branch of sharp rapid movement, هَلُوعًا becomes target-seeking acceleration whose ethical valence depends on orientation.

activation_trace.role: Sharp rapid movement supplies a kinetic, rather than purely affective, channel for the focus predicate.
Rushing forward while facing a destination supplies the first collective vector of accelerated desire.
Hopeful greed in the heart supplies the desired endpoint that pulls the rushing crowd.
Speed as the opposite of slowness supplies the final scene's explicit acceleration.
An upright conspicuous object supplies a fixed visual target that organizes otherwise restless speed.

structural_cues: The branchless و ف ض occurrence at 70:43 is used only as a syntactic motion cue beside branch-backed س ر ع and ن ص ب, never as a citation or trigger root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forward rushing, coveting, speed, and a visible destination; I infer that reactive speed takes its value from its target. A live alternative is that the crowd scenes are eschatological tableaux and do not analyze the focus predicate.

changed_reading.before: هَلُوعًا is only inward anxiety and possessiveness.
changed_reading.after: هَلُوعًا can also be embodied target acquisition: human energy accelerates toward salient goods or markers before judgment of the destination catches up.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later repetition of creation addresses a coveting crowd, then places that crowd under the possibility that another may stand in its place with superior quality. This weakens any deterministic use of خُلِقَ: formed disposition neither excuses conduct nor guarantees status.

activation_trace.role: Inner disposition supplies the baseline temptation to read the trait as fixed destiny.
Anxious grasping supplies the created default whose normative force is being tested.
Originating and bringing into being repeats creaturely dependence in direct relation to the crowd.
One thing standing in another's place makes continued human occupancy contingent rather than guaranteed.
Superior goodness and selection provide the criterion by which a replacement can exceed the present crowd.

structural_cues: 70:39 repeats خلق immediately after the crowd's claim to entry, and 70:41 follows with the possibility of replacement by better others.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated creation and population-level replacement; I infer that created disposition is not an excuse or entitlement. The live alternative is important: replacement of a population does not by itself prove transformation within an individual.

changed_reading.before: Created anxiety fixes both behavior and standing, making the focus clause deterministic.
changed_reading.after: The focus clause names a creaturely default without granting immunity or permanence: conduct remains answerable, and human occupancy is contingent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the rare focus branch names male and female goat kids and crosses species domains. It remains anchored to ه ل ع and the focus creation/form construction; downstream prose should present it only as a developmental material analogy, not as the lexical translation of هَلُوعًا or an assertion that humans are animals of that kind.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus predicate's inventory contains young goat bodies explained through skittishness, while the creation root supplies completed bodily formation.

activation_trace.role: Complete well-proportioned form supplies the newly formed body in which the analogy is housed.
Male and female goat kids supply a literal juvenile image whose skittishness models immature regulation.
Sharp rapid movement gives the juvenile image its startle-and-bolt dynamics.

changed_reading.before: هَلُوعًا is an abstract adult moral defect.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can be pictured as juvenile skittishness: a formed body startles and bolts before learned regulation can organize its energy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the specialized image of the little human figure in the pupil and connects it to distant sight clauses. It remains anchored in the focus noun and is reinforced by context occurrences of sight; downstream prose should qualify it as a visual-social analogy, not the ordinary lexical sense of ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ in 70:19.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ has a pupil-image branch, while the context makes persons visible to one another and ends with lowered eyes.

activation_trace.role: The little human image reflected in the pupil supplies a miniature person constituted within another's gaze.
Anxious impatience supplies the inner pressure that relational visibility exposes.
Ocular seeing supplies the scene in which persons are made perceptually present to one another under crisis.
Ocular sight attached to lowered eyes closes the context with exposed visibility becoming humbled vision.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes an isolated internal temperament.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the anxious human is also a reflected and exposed social figure: crisis makes being seen part of the pressure architecture.

strongest_changes: The paired touch clauses turn a broad trait into a symmetric control failure: harm ends endurance while good ends circulation.
The prayer-and-rights exception changes created disposition from immutable destiny into a governable architecture with temporal and social regulators.
The ransom and storage sequence expands grasping from private stinginess into a threat economy that reallocates persons and possessions in opposite directions.
summary.what_was_special: The rare ه ل ع inventory holds alarm, grasping, speed, and a juvenile-body image at once. The context distributes those potentials across horizon, touch, storage, recurring practice, social claims, and crowd motion without requiring one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The prayer profile may describe stable exceptions rather than a causal process that retrains the same disposition.
The distant-near contrast may correct eschatological appraisal without causally explaining human alarm.
The acceleration reading is branch-distant and may belong only to the later crowd scenes.
Population-level replacement in 70:41 does not by itself establish individual psychological plasticity.
